text: BAM share fell 0.1 percentage points over 24 hours to 32.7%, but remains up 0.22 percentage points over 7 days. Concentration is elevated: the largest node holds 23.4% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The top-node lead changed hands 58 times in the window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover.
